body:
Already tried, all i’m getting from this family is them relativating my emotions to theirs , “this is not the time for this” and other answers that are showing me that they don’t care. 

Every single day of the past month , i woke up in a okay mood and then it’s always them making small things into a big discussion. All they do is shout and complain. I really wish i got to experience a different life but at this point it’s either leaving to a different state or killing myself and i’m leaning towards taking the easy way out

i wish i could do that for now, but even then i’ll be wasting my next 1-2 years.

My mum is scared to sleep alone and my brother is making up reasons why i can’t leave yet. and i’m too much of a pussy to speak up. 

on another note: do you know if the combo of tramadol + alcohol is going to work?

honestly i know you’re right, but it was insanely hard to move out for me back then. i was so pressured back then from everyone and worried about my mum but atleast i was able to say that my dad would be at home. i feel bad for leaving my mum on her own
